title: Security

[vc_row][vc_column][smartslider3 slider="29"][vc_empty_space height="25px"][eikra-vc-text-title style="style2" title="Campus Security"][/eikra-vc-text-title][vc_tta_accordion active_section="-1"][vc_tta_section title="CCTV" tab_id="1652179591741-125f1f55-d3b6"][vc_column_text]

Video Surveillance or CCTV are used to observe an area and connected to a recording device or IP Network and monitored in a Server Room. CCTV’s are placed at the strategic locations in the campus to keep track of situations in Campus.

No. of CCTV’s in Campus- 140

[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title="SECURITY PERSONNEL" tab_id="1652179591752-1ea2e35a-2dbf"][vc_column_text]

The security section of the institute is entrusted to provide security and safety to all the people on campus including students, faculty and staff members and security personnel also work for the safety of assets on the campus.

  • Security Persons will regulate and maintain traffic, both vehicular and pedestrian on the campus.
  • Will ensure that the campus is free from trespassers and squatters, to deal with defaulters if any inappropriate manners.
  • To deal with entry/exit of departments, sections, offices excess control of which have been entrusted to Security Section.
[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title="FIRE EXTINGUISHER" tab_id="1652179879072-1e865d19-a76b"][vc_column_text]

ATME College of Engineering provides fire extinguishers which is an active fire protection device used to extinguish or control small fires, often in emergency situations. Typically, a fire extinguisher consists of a hand-held cylindrical pressure vessel containing an agent which can be discharged to extinguish a fire. Fire extinguishers manufactured with non-cylindrical pressure vessels also exist but are less common.

No. of Fire Extinguishers in Campus- 37

First aid is the assistance given to any person suffering a serious illness or injury, with care provided to preserve life, prevent the condition from worsening, or to promote recovery.

No. of First Aid kit in Campus- 23
